host: Windows x64, Unity Editor 6000.3.23f1, Mono, loopback, no injected network delay. Throughput values count application frames.
sendWorkload: Four interleaved configurations, one warm-up round then 12 measured per configuration. 1 ms idle gap before each first-send latency probe; TCP_NODELAY enabled on sender. Each throughput sample has 192 bursts of 64 x 128-byte bodies. Time to peer consumption and last local completion. ProfilerRecorder GC.Alloc positive control 64 allocations, records only the submitting thread.
receiveWorkload: Two independent Editor processes, interleaved A/B; one warm-up then 12 measured rounds per scenario per mode. Identical batch+cache sending and frame reads. Dispatch = wall-clock duration of nonempty Pump calls / number of delivered frames, with callback; excludes idle polls. Latency includes offered peer group to callback. Push: 2048 frames in 64-frame groups, manual continuous pumping. Lag: same workload, main sleeps 2 ms every 64 deliveries. Update: 12 groups of eight per connection delivered through normal Core updates, offered sequentially; loopback Editor frame pacing is variable.
receiverDecision: Keep the bounded Queue and Monitor implementation (A). B failed the normal Update P95 regression gate in process 1. All three scenarios and both processes must pass; prior to running, threshold was >=5% dispatch or throughput improvement, <=5% regression in the other and P95 latency.
